gate: On confirm (g22/g23, HO0-s17 dump): every-frame VOC >= unmodified + 1.0 and annotated-frame VOC >= unmodified - 0.5; the selected setting must also gain >= 0.5 every-frame on tune.
one_variable: Post-hoc temporal erosion of dense frame detections: per video and class, frames whose best detection scores >= s_min form segments (gaps <= 2 bridged); detections in the outer k frames of a segment are multiplied by eps. Frame metrics only; model unchanged.
purpose: Confident detections on action-free frames sit mostly within a few frames of annotated actions (tune: 48% within 8 frames). If detected segments overshoot the annotated interval, eroding their ends removes those detections at little cost on annotated frames. IG1 (gating by tube coverage) and E3 (training on action-free clips) failed.
selection: On tune (g24/g25, HO0-s17 dump): maximise every-frame VOC among settings whose annotated-frame VOC is >= unmodified - 0.5; ties within 0.05 broken by larger eps, then smaller k, then larger s_min.
test_use: If the gate passes, the selected setting is frozen and applied once to the recorded V2-WS2.0 test dump; the eroded detections then define every reported frame-mAP number. If it fails, test is not touched.
